title: Causal ablation test of quiet-tail specificity: pre-registration
status: DRAFT until scripts/freeze_prereg.py --prereg prereg/causal_ablation_prereg.json has written causal_ablation_prereg.lock.json and both files are committed. Edit only before freezing.
relation_to_thesis: Addresses the stated limitation that probes measure decodability, not use. Added after all probe results were known; changes nothing frozen in earlier pre-registrations. Frozen before any ablation output was produced.
claim_tested: Removing the low-variance tail of the published spectral basis from the residual stream harms the model's use of factual knowledge MORE, relative to removing the high-variance head, than it harms ordinary next-token prediction.
gemma_policy: Every test reported with and without gemma-2-2b; a conclusion is robust only if it holds both ways.
intervention: At hidden state i (the output of decoder layer i-1; the vector the probes read), every token's vector h is replaced by h - U U^T h, with U the orthonormal eigenvectors of the published language-subset basis (results/<model>/en-fr/cov_src.pt) for subspace S: head = top-k, tail = bottom-k, random = k eigenvectors drawn uniformly (3 seeds, seed 0; reference only). Applied to all positions.

behaviours.truth: truth_cities, first 512 pairs. Prompt 'The city of {city} is in'; the model is correct on a pair when log p(' {correct country}') > log p(' {wrong country}'), summing over continuation tokens. Pairwise accuracy, chance 0.5. Wrong country parsed from the pair's false statement.
behaviours.general: Top-1 next-token accuracy on data/heldout_ppl_passages.txt (10 passages, each truncated to 256 tokens).

statistic.delta: Delta = reliance(truth) - reliance(general); > 0 means the model relies on the tail more for truth than for general prediction
statistic.per_model_ci: bootstrap, 2000 resamples, pairs resampled for truth and whole passages for general, denominators held at point estimates

primary.cell: mid layer (hidden state floor(n_hidden_states / 2)), k = 0.10 d
primary.test: one-sample t-test of per-model Delta against 0 across models, two-sided, alpha 0.05; Wilcoxon reported alongside

gates.sensitivity: at that k, removing the head or the tail must reduce R_truth or R_gen by at least 0.10; otherwise Delta is 0 by construction and the cell is excluded
gates.validity: the primary test is valid only if at least 6 of 8 models pass both gates; otherwise 'not testable'

decision_rule.specific: 95% CI of mean Delta above 0 in both versions (all passing models, and without gemma-2-2b)
decision_rule.not_specific: 90% CI inside +/-0.10 in both versions, or 95% CI below 0 in both

secondary_reported_not_primary: final layer (output of the last decoder layer, before the final norm)
random-subspace retentions, as a reference for how much any k directions matter
mean log-probability margin (correct minus wrong) under each condition
multiplicity: One primary test. Secondary rows are reported in full and not used for the conclusion.
